_source: DESCANSO Design and Performance Summary Series (JPL, public): MRO (Taylor, Lee, Shambayati 2006, MRO_092106.pdf) Tables 2-1, 2-2, 2-4, 4-3 to 4-6; MSL (Makovsky, Ilott, Taylor 2009, Descanso14_MSL_Telecom.pdf) Tables 1-6, 2-9, 2-11, 2-12; MarCO (DESCANSO 18) Tables 5-3 to 5-5; Mars Odyssey (DESCANSO 2) Table 5-3.

defaults._note: An element with no comms fields gets MSL's rover X-band chain: a 15 W SSPA and a low-gain antenna (DESCANSO 14). Circuit loss 1.3 dB is MarCO's HGA path (DESCANSO 18 Table 5-4, line 8).

lga._note: MRO LGA boresight gains (MRO Table 2-2); mass of an MSL PLGA (MSL Table 2-11).

hga._note: Efficiency fitted to MRO's 3 m HGA, 46.7 dBi at 8.439 GHz (Table 2-2). Reflector 19.1 kg plus 1.1 kg hardware over 7.07 m^2, feed 1.6 kg (MRO Table 2-1). Gimbal: MRO 45 kg for 3 m (Table 2-1), MSL rover 6.6 kg (MSL Table 2-11).

sspa._note: MSL rover SSPA: 15 W RF, 55 W DC nominal, 1.4 kg (MSL Tables 2-9, 2-11).

twta._note: MSL descent-stage TWTA: 100 W RF, 175.2 W DC operating, 2.5 kg (MSL Tables 2-11, 2-12). MRO measured 102 W RF from 172 W (efficiency 0.59).

twta_ka._note: MRO Ka-band TWTA: 34 W RF from 81 W DC; tube 0.8 kg plus converter 1.5 kg (MRO Table 2-1).

transponder._note: SDST: 3.0 kg, 14.4 W coherent transmit, 11.4 W receive only (MSL Tables 2-11, 2-12); receiver threshold -156 dBm (MRO Table 2-3); system noise 480.9 K as MarCO's MGA uplink budget (DESCANSO 18 Table 5-3, line 21).

uhf._note: Electra-Lite radio about 3 kg (MSL sec. 2.6.3) plus a 0.7 kg antenna; 71 W DC full duplex (MRO Electra, Table 2-1); 14.8 W RF transmit and 401.586 MHz return frequency (InSight, DESCANSO 18 Table 5-5); Electra coded thresholds (MRO Table 2-4).

turbo_1/3._note: CCSDS 131.0 turbo (8920 bit frame), FER 1e-4, about 0.4 dB above rate 1/6

uncoded_cmd._note: uncoded command, BER 1e-5, MarCO Table 5-3 lines 35-36

uhf_plasma_blackout._note: UHF only: the plasma sheath of peak heating cuts the UHF relay (MSL Table 1-6: 25 to 100 s); X-band is not cut. Our own rule (not a published model): blackout while airspeed > 5 km/s between 25 and 90 km; checked against MSL's 25 to 100 s band in dev/test_comms_range.py.
